name: Oblivion Access
source:
The last thing I see is stretched through a tunnel and I’m soused with telepathic omniscience while I’m suffused with radio through the non-Euclidean planes. Out of this world and into the icy black nebula, volute wormholes exteriorize me for transcendence. I respire the broadcasted wafts of suspiria from the cadaver of a sickly artificial sun. Disquiet consorts exult. I’m we, and we’re mummified with thought. Thoughts are maligned and intertwined. DNA is quantized through channels. And he drinks through the channels and rivers of analog waves. He drinks.

[From [url=https://ashirah.itch.io/oblivion-access]itch.io[/url]]
